name: tool-till-tees
title: Utilities API
description: Contact form endpoint, multi-tenant form builder, and agreement management backend. All backed by Supabase.
audience: Internal — the backend that powers contact forms, the form builder (four-ems), and agreement management (sun-sea-o). Not used directly by end users.
useCases: A visitor submits a contact form on see-veo — tool-till-tees receives the data, validates it, and delivers it via email
A form built in four-ems collects submissions — tool-till-tees stores them with row-level security and exposes them to the form owner’s dashboard
Two parties sign an agreement module in sun-sea-o — tool-till-tees records the signatures, sends notifications, and generates a verifiable PDF
A new frontend needs a form endpoint — tool-till-tees provides a multi-tenant API with CORS allowlisting and input validation out of the box

dataPrivacy.storage: All data stored in Supabase (PostgreSQL) with row-level security.
dataPrivacy.authentication: JWT-based anonymous auth. Users can only access their own data.
dataPrivacy.security: CORS allowlist, input validation, HTML escaping, honeypot fields, security headers.
